content: Plan 9's compiler suite (ken lineage, described in Thompson's 'Plan 9 C Compilers' paper) shares a common frontend in cmd/cc with per-arch code generators (5c arm, 6c amd64...). 9front's 7c (arm64) is the proven modern example of adding an arch to this suite. The practical port path is: copy the nearest relative (5c for arm64), rewrite the machine-dependent passes (codegen, register allocation, peephole), add 7a assembler + 7l linker with the arch's object format.
